annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (Chapter 634, Senate Bill 720) – Education – Artificial Intelligence – Guidelines, Professional Development, and Collaborative
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (Maryland Chapter 634, Senate Bill 720)
named_instruments_referenced: Maryland State Finance and Procurement Article Title 3.5 Subtitle 8
annotation.summary_en: Maryland's Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (Ch. 634, 2026) requires the State Department of Education to issue AI guidance for K-12 schools. Local school systems must adopt AI policies, name AI coordinators and evaluate AI tools against a state rubric. The Act also requires AI literacy standards and educator professional development, and it creates a Maryland AI Education Collaborative.
key_provisions_or_claims: Department must provide online AI guidance promoting safe, responsible, equitable and ethical use, separately for students, educators, administrators and parents
Each local school system must adopt an AI policy within 120 days of guidance and designate an AI coordinator
Department must publish a rubric that local systems must use to evaluate and select AI tools; procurement must follow state AI procurement law
AI literacy to be included in K-12 workforce and computer science standards by June 1, 2027, plus mandated educator professional development
Establishes the Maryland AI Education Collaborative with annual reporting, sunset May 31, 2028
